description: List Canton Network Dev Fund grant proposals: community funding requests tracked on GitHub. Filterable by state (open/closed/all). Use for 'what grants/funding requests exist' questions. NOT the same as Canton Improvement Proposals (CIPs): those are governance specs (use list_cips / get_cip). Returns number, title, state, author, board status and how many people commented; it is only an index. For one proposal in full (champion evidence, proposal file, every comment, review and timeline event) call get_proposal and get_proposal_discussion. Canton ecosystem only.

limit.description: How many proposals to return. Default 20, max 50. The response states the full count.

offset.description: Skip this many before returning, for paging past the limit. The response states the full count and echoes the offset used.

state.description: Grant-request state on GitHub. Defaults to "open", so the total reported is open requests rather than every proposal ever filed.

name: get_proposals
